system.description:
ALTERATION INVESTED WARDING

Level 14; Price 31,000 gp; Usage held weapon; Weight 8 lbs

This wonderfully crafted Nodachi is engraved with symbols of animals.

The weapon has the following statistics:

AB +15; Damage 1d10+2 S; Size L; Fumble 3; Traits Balanced, Brace, Centred II, Deadly, Keen, Potency III, Soulful II, Versatile P

Activate Command (1 AP); Frequency Upon a successful critical hit.

The weapon casts a Fear (DC 20) spell on the target of the critical hit.

Automated: a specific weapon (B9-8): a Master Nodachi (the printed 1d10+2 is its die and Master's +2) with the superior trait Balanced and Potency III, Centred II and Soulful Strike II; its attack bonus is what the sheet derives, and its fumble DC is the Nodachi's 12, less 1 for Balanced. On a critical hit you are offered Fear (DC 20) on the creature struck (Command, 1 AP), as Da Big Itter's Fear is. Soulful Strike II is switched on and off on the weapon (Command, 1 AP).

Note for the GM: the book prints "Fumble 3"; it is read as the Nodachi's own fumble DC (B9-8). Graham ruled on 27 October 2026 that Balanced still takes 1 from it, so the fumble DC is 11.
